cases.label: citation_present
cases.guards_against: The source preview stops drawing a box for a cited field, or a "View source region" link no longer lands on its box (click-to-source broken on a vector lab PDF).

cases.label: citation_present
cases.guards_against: Click-to-source breaks on a rasterized intake PDF: a cited field has no box on the page image, or a link targets a missing box.

cases.label: factually_consistent
cases.guards_against: The local-lexical retriever stops expanding a lab abbreviation into its condition, so a fatigue intake with the question "what does the low hgb suggest" ranks an unrelated kidney-test chunk first instead of an anemia chunk.

cases.label: factually_consistent
cases.guards_against: When the Gemini embed call fails and the deployed hybrid retriever falls back to BM25, a lab report with a low hemoglobin and a high A1C gets three A1C chunks and no anemia guideline, because the hemoglobin finding is no longer expanded to its condition.
